title: checkride baseline
description: Schema for checkride.baseline.json — the committed, per-slot set of grandfathered finding keys that `checkride baseline` writes and every run reads. Describes what checkride WRITES: fields are additive under schema_version 1, added in lockstep with this schema, never renamed, removed, or retyped without a version bump. The reader is more tolerant — unknown fields ignored, malformed entries dropped, a newer schema_version rejected whole. See docs/contract.md.

schema_version.description: Version of this file's shape, independent of the summary's schema_version. Bumped only for a breaking (non-additive) change; a reader drops a file from a newer version rather than half-reading it.

slots.description: Slot name (lint, struct, spell, prose, dead, dupes, health, or a config custom-check key) to the sorted set of grandfathered finding keys. A fingerprintable slot with nothing to grandfather is present with an empty array; a slot whose adapter has no extractor is absent.

items.description: An opaque finding key built by the slot's extractor: `<file>:<rule>:<message>` for oxlint/ast-grep/cspell/vale (no line or column), category-and-symbol for fallow. Compare and count keys; never parse them.
